visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation opens on a blank white background with a cartoon orange tabby cat standing centrally. The cat has its eyes closed in a serene smile, small pink ears, and white paws held up near its face. Above it, large black text in Traditional Chinese is centered, while a small copyright notice appears at the bottom edge. (2) The character suddenly transforms its expression to one of intense determination. Its eyes pop open into large white ovals with tiny black pupils, and its orange eyebrows slant inward sharply. The cat clenches its paws into small circular fists, shifting its weight as if preparing for a challenge while maintaining its central position. (3) The cat character physically trips, its body rotating forward until its face makes direct contact with the white floor. Only the back of its head, its upright striped tail, and two small white paws kicking in the air are visible, effectively conveying a slapstick stumble or a 'face-plant' against the void. (4) The cat pops back up into a sitting position, now sporting a glamorous makeover including thick black eyeliner, long eyelashes, and bright pink lipstick. Small yellow four-pointed star and flower graphics sparkle around its head. A second line of Traditional Chinese text appears directly beneath the first line, completing the visual message.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Audio opens with a high-pitched, resonant 'ding' sound effect resembling a triangle or a bell chime. Simultaneously, a bouncy, upbeat electronic BGM starts playing at a tempo of approximately 124 BPM. The music features a synthesized, staccato melody with a playful, lighthearted tone and no vocal components. (2) A short, percussive 'thud' sound effect with a low-frequency transient is heard, cutting through the bright melodic BGM. This sound has a very short decay and simulates a physical impact or a drop. The background music continues its rhythmic pattern without interruption, maintaining a consistent volume and comedic energy throughout this transient event. (3) A shimmering, high-frequency 'magic sparkle' sound effect swells in volume, characterized by a rapid succession of tinkling, metallic transients. This sound effect lasts for approximately two seconds, layered over the final bars of the upbeat BGM. The track ends with a clean cut, preserving the bright and whimsical acoustic texture until the very last frame.
